prompt:
Create one production game sprite pose sheet for Eterno Retorno. Use the attached local image as the visual identity reference ONLY: same person, face, hair, clothing palette, improvised weapon and American comic drawing style. Crisp expressive black ink, clean cel-shaded flat colors, modest material detail, thin ivory-white cutout outline around the whole figure and tools, genuine transparent alpha background. NOT pixel art, NOT blurry, NOT low-res, NOT pencil sketch. Six separate FULL BODY static illustrations in an exact regular 3 columns x 2 rows grid, landscape 1536x1024 or larger (prefer 3072x2048). Each cell is square and isolated, generous clear transparent gutters and outer padding; nothing overlaps another cell or crosses its boundaries. Same anatomical scale and head size across ALL six poses; full boots and tools visible with no cropping. All face toward the right. No scenery, no ground shadow, no captions, no text, no frames, no spark/light effects (those run separately in the game). Cell order reading left to right: TOP LEFT = strong attack contact pose using the tool/weapon; TOP MIDDLE = guarded defensive stance protecting face and torso using existing equipment; TOP RIGHT = tactical support/skill gesture with existing equipment; BOTTOM LEFT = recoil from being hit while keeping both feet on the ground; BOTTOM MIDDLE = defeated slumped seated/kneeling pose with lowered head and tool, same head size, NOT flat prone and NOT gore; BOTTOM RIGHT = neutral upright combat-ready reference pose for scale comparison, near the input idle stance. These are six action stills, NOT a sprite animation sequence.
Character: Alma the civilian teacher: adult woman, short tousled silver-grey hair, small yellow hair clip, violet long work coat with teal lining, off-white shirt, brown cross-body satchel, charcoal work trousers and brown laced boots. Her weapon is an improvised handheld electrical coil with antenna rods and a wrapped handle in her right hand; a small closed tan notebook is held in her left. Attack aims the coil forcefully to the right with both feet firmly planted and a concentrated expression; guard raises a braced forearm and holds the coil across the torso defensively (no magical bubble); skill adjusts the coil's control while consulting the notebook. Preserve the teacher's face and costume; no wizard robes or fantasy staff.
processing: Six disconnected authored drawings; isolate connected silhouettes at alpha > 0.2 with 1px antialias fringe; common proportional downscale only; baseline 496, centered on 512px transparent canvas; reference pose supplies consistent anatomical scale; one static runtime image per action
